lines.text: Leo spent the afternoon digging in sandbox castles and painting rainbow posters!
Time for lunch! shouted Mom. Leo ran straight to the table to grab a sandwich!
Hold on! Look through the magic science magnifying glass at your fingers!
Millions of microscopic germ monsters were doing silly dances on his palms!
Leo turned on the warm water tap and pumped out silky, strawberry soap!
Scrub the fronts! Scrub the backs! Scrub between the fingers for twenty seconds!
Whoosh! The soap bubbles lifted the germ monsters and flushed them away!
Clean hands keep your tummy happy, healthy, and ready for delicious meals!
Wash up and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily health facts!
